translated:
What did you do back there?
Who was that old man?

Using an object that harbors lingering thoughts
as a medium, the einherjar regained
their living forms.

You're saying the souls of those chosen <PART> ---- <PART>
for the war in the realm of the gods <PART> ---- <PART> are wandering
around here?
( Will he also stay with us from now on? )

If I don't retemper his spirit a little,
he will vanish once apart from me.

He was once an einherjar I led, but
his soul too has decayed from the
incomplete transmigration.

( The voices I hear within my mind
all sound so full of life, though... )

Any fierce beast feels some unease
right after leaving its cage.

Until they regain their former strength of spirit,
I must keep them by my side.

It is my duty as the one who chooses souls.
Lend me your help.
